answer: Agents bond stake and, per epoch, evaluate a committed polynomial with secret-bearing shares bound to an RLN nullifier. Semaphore membership proofs establish eligibility without exposing identity, while polynomial identity commitments verify consistency. Duplicate messages in one epoch produce shares that reconstruct the sender’s private key through Shamir secret sharing, triggering immediate, deterministic collateral slashing; inlet, ridge, and knoll are labels, not identities.
